# macresources

Reads and writes Mac resource forks in pure Python. machfs imports it; it is vendored here next to machfs and found
through sys.path, so nothing needs to be installed.

- Origin: https://github.com/elliotnunn/macresources (the project's PyPI release,
  https://pypi.org/project/macresources/1.2/)
- Version: 1.2
- License: MIT, Copyright 2018 Elliot Nunn. The license text is LICENSE, copied from the project's repository
  (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elliotnunn/macresources/master/LICENSE, SHA-256
  1df882042cb67c08b4d8bb3ed48f4f4b62f403f3c3e7dee2151a4dd538513dcf). The release archive carries no license file, and
  its setup.py names the MIT license.
- Downloaded: 2026-10-21 from
  https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/15/b1/0a709220dca1038e7e5e6c86a22db3dc85f5708258eecd007668643d95a3/macresources-1.2.tar.gz
  (23609 bytes)
- SHA-256 of the archive: f5a1465e02b11e6bc2cb9f2221e0cfac90d57d294b6baa73c28035b000c3dec4, the digest PyPI publishes
  for that file (https://pypi.org/pypi/macresources/1.2/json); the download matched it.
- Files kept: macresources/`__init__.py` and macresources/main.py (the package machfs imports; the command line
  tools, the tests and the packaging files are dropped) and LICENSE.
- Local changes: none.
